_doc: Pause card 'Where next?'. story: in order; the hint is the step after the furthest one done (flag_done set). postgame (after game_complete): the first not done; 'all' needs every flag; {caught} {total} {legends} are filled in. town rings that town or place on the world map; map [x, y] rings a spot with no map entry. rematches: daily keys from the Keepers' rematch scripts.

story.text: Professor Garside is expecting you at the Field Station, just outside Macclesfield.
Take the old road east over the moor to Buxton. Keeper Maud holds the Brook Stone at the spa.
Head north to Manchester. Bev at Bev's Bikes has something for a new Stone holder.
On to Liverpool. Keeper Ray holds the Urban Stone at the Cavern (ish).
Into Wales by way of Chester. Keeper Eluned holds the Stone Stone up at the quarry in Llanberis.
Climb Yr Wyddfa. Something is stirring at the summit.
South to Cardiff. Keeper Rhys holds the Storm Stone at the Cardiff Arena.
East over the Severn to Glastonbury. Keeper Morwen holds the Fae Stone up on the Tor.
West into Cornwall. Sir Rupert Ashcombe is up to something at Tintagel.
Follow Ashcombe down the Geevor Tin Mine, out past Penzance.
Ferry ticket in hand: get to Holyhead, over Anglesey, and sail for Dublin.
Keeper Declan holds the Kin Stone at Dublin Hall.
Take the Wicklow road to Kilkenny. Director Kerrigan is waiting.
West to Galway. Keeper Nuala holds the Tide Stone down at the docks.
Newgrange, for the solstice. Get inside the passage tomb before Kerrigan does.
North over the Mournes to Belfast. Keeper Ruairi holds the Iron Stone at the Belfast Yard.
Up the Antrim coast to the Giant's Causeway. Lord Vane has put up a marquee.
Sail from Belfast to Cairnryan and make for Edinburgh. Kit is up at the Castle.
Director Strachan is out in the mist at Glencoe.
Strachan's survey boat is out on Loch Ness.
Keeper Isla holds the Frost Stone at the Inverness Ice Rink.
East through the Cairngorms to Aberdeen. Garside has been trying to reach you.
The long road south to York. Keeper Hester holds the Spirit Stone in the Minster crypt.
All ten Stones. Make for Stonehenge, south of Salisbury Plain. Kit is at the gate.
Win the Moot: four Winds and a Champion, back to back, no Sanctuary in between.
Vane has the Wardstones in his glass tower in London. Climb it and stop him.

postgame.text: Bran's Raven is waiting on the lawn at the Tower of London.
{legends} of 10 legends caught. The rest are still out at the old places they woke in.
The standing stones of Orkney still have a secret or two.
The Isle of Man keeps a few secrets of its own. Mind your manners.
Fill the Fieldbook ({caught} of {total} caught), then show Professor Garside.
You've seen it all. The Keepers, Kit and Garside take a rematch once a day, and the kettle's always on.
